build_MultigridNetwork: build a MultigridNetwork actor-critic module with observation space, action space, and optional LSTM recurrent architecture
create_MultigridNetwork_act: create an action selection by calling act on a MultigridNetwork with inputs, RNN hidden states, and masks
run_MultigridNetwork_get_value: run the critic value head on a MultigridNetwork to get state value estimates from inputs
test_MultigridNetwork_evaluate_actions: test action evaluation by calling evaluate_actions on a MultigridNetwork to get log probabilities and entropy
review_MultigridNetwork_forward_base: review the _forward_base method to understand how image, scalar, and positional embeddings are combined before the RNN
